# CANDIDATE: VWAP_REJECTION_RSI_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bearish RSI divergence at a VWAP breach with above-average volume signals short-term exhaustion and reversal opportunity. This edge exists because VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance, RSI divergence indicates weakening momentum, and volume confirmation adds conviction to the breakdown.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On a 5-minute bar, if price closes below VWAP, the 14-period RSI forms a lower high while price forms a higher high (bearish divergence), and bar volume exceeds 1.5x the 20-period average volume, enter short at the bar's close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed above the most recent swing high or above VWAP, whichever is higher. Target at 1.5x risk or exit when price returns to VWAP. Regime filters: VIX > 18, time 11:00-13:00 EST, and price action showing a series of lower highs (short-term downtrend).
